items.title: Qatar Airways Airbus A321LRs With Flat Bed Business Class Launching Soon
items.why: Qatar Airways expects its first Airbus A321LR within weeks, fitted with a 1-1 flat-bed business seat.
items.summary_ai: Qatar Airways expects its first Airbus A321LR within weeks, fitted with a 1-1 flat-bed business seat.

items.title: LATAM Unveils New Airbus A321XLR Business Class Suites, Coming March 2027
items.why: LATAM plans to introduce new business class suites on its Airbus A321XLR aircraft beginning in March 2027.
items.summary_ai: LATAM plans to introduce new business class suites on its Airbus A321XLR aircraft beginning in March 2027.
